title: Onboarding insight mosaic: latency/cost/tracecards for first-run tour
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and deliver a set of compact 'insight mosaic' cards and annotated product screenshots to appear in the first-run onboarding tour for Observability. Focus domains: end-to-end latency distribution, cost-per-token breakdown, and a condensed trace flame/step view. The goal is to give new users a visual 'first glance' that communicates where to go for deeper analysis, and to produce a screenshot kit for docs and release notes (3 artboards: latency mosaic, cost-breakdown mosaic, tracecards). Avoid duplicating existing quickstart assets; these should be smaller, more contextual, and optimized for mobile/compact console panes.
acceptance_criteria: Three finalized artboards exported at 2x PNG and SVG (latency mosaic, cost-per-token breakdown, tracecards)
Each artboard includes an explanatory 1-sentence header, one CTA link placement, and tooltip callouts for two key metrics
Assets validated against console theme (dark/light) and accessible contrast guidelines
Design handoff notes include exact component sizes, font tokens, color tokens, and recommended responsive breakpoints
PM and Eng have reviewed and signed off on content accuracy and export formats
